title: Winter foods per mizaj
caption:
Gajar halwa season is here. Your mizaj has notes.

Unani tradition suggests eating with the season and with your temperament. Winter is often the happiest season for warm mizaj and the trickiest for cool ones. Here's what tradition suggests for each, from saag and yakhni to soaked anjeer.
